annotations.title: Make images for many products at once

description: Bulk mode: starts image sets for many products in one call (up to 500; the account’s plan sets the limit). Each product is a product page url, public image_urls, upload_ids, or a product_id the account already has, with an optional name, description and facts. It runs in the background: each product is read, planned and, with mode "run", its images start as soon as its plan is written; with mode "review" each product stops at its plan until start_batch. One product failing never stops the others. Nothing starts beyond what is left (the plan’s products per batch and per day, and the credits for mode run): the dry run’s fits says how many products (from the first) can start now. Call with dry_run true first and tell the person the most it can cost and how many fit; if not all fit, offer the first fits products or buying credits (buy_credits); then call without dry_run. Credits are spent per product when its images start (1 credit per 2K image). Returns the batch id; follow it with get_batch. Example: {"mode": "run", "packs": ["amazon", "etsy"], "items": [{"url": "https://shop.example.com/products/mug"}, {"image_urls": ["https://cdn.example.com/apron.jpg"], "name": "Linen apron"}], "dry_run": true}

brand_kit_id.description: A brand kit for every product; null = no brand; omitted = each product’s brand

dry_run.description: Only check the products and return the most it can cost

facts.description: Facts printed word for word, e.g. {"dimensions": "12 x 8 in (30 x 20 cm)"}

image_urls.description: Public photo links of one product

pack.description: Platform pack: amazon, amazon-aplus, etsy, shopify, tiktok-shop (square images for every TikTok Shop region); social ads: social (static ad images) or social-carousel (square carousel ad cards, one selling point each); social organic: instagram-grid (photo posts, the product in a different scene each, no text) or organic-carousel (a 4:5 brand campaign carousel); or storyboard (a video storyboard sheet). Pick how many posts, slides or cards with the shots list.

packs.description: This product’s platforms instead of the batch’s

product_id.description: A product the account already has

url.description: A product page (Amazon, Etsy, Shopify or any shop)

locale.description: Language of text on the images, e.g. "de"

mode.description: "run" (default): make everything; "review": write every plan first, then start_batch

name.description: A name for the batch and the folder its products go in

pack.description: One platform for every product (same as packs with one entry)

packs.description: The platforms every product gets, one image set each, e.g. ["amazon", "etsy"] (needed unless each item has its own)
